data.content: ["Surfside Beach offers a laid-back outdoor escape with low costs and excellent food options perfect for accommodating Nina's vegan needs, Omar's preferences, and Priya's vegetarian meals in a relaxed morning-friendly beach town.", "Clearwater Beach combines iconic beachside outdoor activities with a thriving local food scene that can support diverse dietary restrictions, while maintaining the calm, slow-paced atmosphere your group needs with no rushed morning schedules.", "Finger Lakes delivers scenic outdoor walks through vineyards and lakeside parks with excellent farm-to-table restaurants accommodating vegan and vegetarian diets, plus a naturally slow-paced setting ideal for relaxed mornings and cultural exploration.", "Niagara Falls provides stunning outdoor scenery and walkable exploration with museums and parks, plus diverse dining options to meet Nina's vegan and Omar and Priya's vegetarian requirements in a moderate-cost destination.", "Matagorda offers an ultra-affordable beach escape with pristine outdoor activities, minimal travel between relaxation spots, and accessible local food vendors who can accommodate vegan and vegetarian dietary needs in a genuinely slow-paced coastal setting."]
